tool.name: ampvis2 rank abundance plot
tool.command: Rscript '$__tool_directory__/rankabundance.R' --input '$input' --metadata '$metadata' #if $advanced.advanced == 'yes': --otu_level $advanced.otu_level --min_abund $advanced.min_abund --max_abund $advanced.max_abund --step $advanced.step #if str($advanced.plot_type) != '': --plot_type '$advanced.plot_type' #end if #if str($advanced.std_dev) != '': --std_dev '$advanced.std_dev' #end if #end if --output '$output'

param.label: Metadata table
param.help: Metadata table produced by the "load" tool.

param.label: OTU level
param.help: Level of the OTUs to consider.

param.label: Minimum abundance
param.help: Only OTUs with abundance greater or equal to this value will be considered.

param.label: Maximum abundance
param.help: Only OTUs with abundance lower or equal to this value will be considered.

tool.help:
What it does ============
Generates a rank abundance curve (rank abundance vs cumulative read abundance), optionally with standard deviation from mean intervals.
The Galaxy tool calls the `amp_rankabundance <https://kasperskytte.github.io/ampvis2/reference/amp_rankabundance.html>`_ function of the ampvis2 package.
Currently only OTU level is supported.
Input =====
An ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained by the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or one of the ``ampvis2: subset ...`` tools).
The metadata list output of the ``ampvis2: load`` tool (or ``ampvis2: mergereplicates`` or the ``ampvis2: subset sample`` tool). This input is only used for providing values to the parameters alowing to select metadata variables or values.
Output ======
An rank abundance plot in the chosen output format.
